problem:
Aluminum-26 has a half-life of $0.717$ million years. A sample of aluminum-26 has an initial mass of $40\,\mu \text{g}.$ Rounded to **one decimal place**, what is the mass of the sample after $1$ million years?

The mass of the sample after $1$ million years is approximately
{{field-1}}
$\mu \text{g}.$
